XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for Moodle local/quizextensionmanager. NOTE: the spec's conceptual tables 'quiz_settings' and 'course_settings' are stored here as 'quizextensionmanager_quizset' and 'quizextensionmanager_crsset' respectively -- Moodle limits unprefixed table names to 28 characters (for Oracle/cross-DB compatibility), and 'quizextensionmanager_quiz_settings' / 'quizextensionmanager_course_settings' both exceed that, so the suffixes are abbreviated. Column lists are unchanged from the spec.

TABLE.NAME: quizextensionmanager_request
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per student quiz time-extension request.

FIELD.NAME: quizid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to quiz.id.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Denormalized from quiz.course for cheaper course-level report queries.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to user.id. The requesting student.

FIELD.NAME: requestedtimeclose
FIELD.COMMENT: Nullable. New close date/time being requested.

FIELD.NAME: requestedtimelimit
FIELD.COMMENT: Nullable. New time limit in seconds, matching quiz.timelimit units.

FIELD.NAME: requestedattempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Nullable. New max attempts requested.

FIELD.NAME: currenttimeclose
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of quiz.timeclose at time of request.

FIELD.NAME: currenttimelimit
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of quiz.timelimit at time of request.

FIELD.NAME: currentattempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of quiz.attempts at time of request.

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Student-supplied free text reason for the request.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: One of: pending, approved, denied, cancelled.

FIELD.NAME: grantedtimeclose
FIELD.COMMENT: Nullable. Close date/time actually granted, may differ from requested.

FIELD.NAME: grantedtimelimit
FIELD.COMMENT: Nullable. Time limit actually granted, may differ from requested.

FIELD.NAME: grantedattempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Nullable. Max attempts actually granted, may differ from requested.

FIELD.NAME: quizoverrideid
FIELD.COMMENT: Soft link to quiz_overrides.id. Used to find/update the single override row per user per quiz.

FIELD.NAME: reviewerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to user.id. Teacher who actioned the request, nullable while pending.

FIELD.NAME: reviewreason
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional comment/reason left by the reviewer.

FIELD.NAME: timereviewed
FIELD.COMMENT: Nullable. Set when approved/denied.

TABLE.NAME: quizextensionmanager_quizset
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-quiz configuration for extension requests (spec: quiz_settings).

FIELD.NAME: quizid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to quiz.id.

FIELD.NAME: enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether extension requests are allowed for this quiz.

FIELD.NAME: requirereason
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether a reason is required to submit a request.

FIELD.NAME: documentationmode
FIELD.COMMENT: One of: none, optional, required.

FIELD.NAME: allowedfiletypes
FIELD.COMMENT: Allowed documentation file types, Moodle filetypes util format.

FIELD.NAME: requestwindowtype
FIELD.COMMENT: One of: days-after-close, fixed-date, until-course-end.

FIELD.NAME: requestwindowdays
FIELD.COMMENT: Nullable. Used when requestwindowtype = days-after-close.

FIELD.NAME: requestwindowdate
FIELD.COMMENT: Nullable timestamp. Used when requestwindowtype = fixed-date.

TABLE.NAME: quizextensionmanager_crsset
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-course configuration for extension requests (spec: course_settings).

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to course.id.

FIELD.NAME: maxrequestsperstudent
FIELD.COMMENT: Nullable = unlimited. Max approved requests allowed per student in this course.

FIELD.NAME: defaultrequestwindowdays
FIELD.COMMENT: Default days-after-close request window used when a quiz does not override it.
